Plan a ride

Pick where you are going. Uber opens with the destination filled in; for Bolt and Little, type it in their app.

Pickup is your current location. Fares are shown and paid inside each app.

Open Uber ↗ Open Bolt ↗

Little: open the Little Ride app on your phone and type the destination.

Popular trips

  • JKIA airport → your stayArrival day
  • Your stay → Talanta StadiumMatchday · leave early

We don't show fare estimates: prices change with traffic and demand, so check the price in the app before you confirm.

Matchday

Pickup and drop-off zones

Roads near the stadium may close on matchdays. We will show the official pickup zones here once the traffic plan is published.

The official matchday traffic plan has not been published yet.

Ride safe

Match the car

Check the plate, car model and driver photo before you get in.

Share your trip

Use the app's share-trip feature so a friend can follow your ride.

Pay the app price

Pay through the app or as it shows. Do not agree a separate cash price.

Expect surge pricing

Fares rise after matches and in rain. Waiting a little or walking to a quieter street can help.

Taking a matatu

Matatus are Nairobi's shared minibuses: cheap and everywhere, but busy.

Ask before you board

Routes are shown on the front of the matatu. Confirm the destination and fare with the conductor before you get in.

Keep valuables close

Matatus get crowded at rush hour and after matches. Keep your phone and wallet out of sight.

Ask a local

Your host or hotel can tell you the right route and stage for where you are going.
